description: Source code for a multi-threaded HTTP server sample using Zephyr RTOS, supporting IPv4 and IPv6, with optional TLS security.

methods.name: event_handler
methods.description: Handles network connection and disconnection events, manages synchronization semaphores.

methods.name: sendall
methods.description: Sends entire buffer over socket, handling partial sends.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Creates, configures, and binds a socket, with optional TLS settings.

methods.name: client_conn_handler
methods.description: Handles individual client connections, processes HTTP requests, and sends responses.

methods.name: get_free_slot
methods.description: Finds an available slot in the accepted connections array.

methods.name: process_tcp
methods.description: Accepts new TCP connections and assigns handlers based on IP version.

methods.name: process_tcp4
methods.description: Sets up IPv4 listening socket and processes incoming connections.

methods.name: process_tcp6
methods.description: Sets up IPv6 listening socket and processes incoming connections.

methods.name: start_listener
methods.description: Starts IPv4 and IPv6 listener threads based on configuration.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes TLS credentials, network event callbacks, starts listener threads, and manages application lifecycle.
